programServices.description: Membership programs and educational woodworking classes: The organization provided membership services to approximately 35 paid members during the period, offering access to woodworking facilities, tools, and educational programming including Basic Woodworking, Intermediate Woodworking, Bandsaw Box, Intro to Hand Tool Woodworking, and specialty SIG (Special Interest Group) sessions covering CNC, Laser Engraver, Finishing, Carving, and Hand Tool disciplines. Membership dues and event registration fees totaling $6,138.00 were collected. Maintenance and repair expenses of $940.00 were incurred to keep equipment and facilities operational for member use.

Landscaping and horticultural services: The organization provided landscaping services including installation of fountains and garden lighting, plants and soil, and sprinkler and drip systems, as well as labor for installation and maintenance. Job materials expenses of $802.82 and automobile expenses of $463.37 and equipment rental of $112.00 and job expenses-other of $155.07 were incurred in delivering these program services. Total landscaping service revenue was $6,986.47 including job materials revenue of $4,736.47 and labor revenue of $300.00 and other landscaping-related income.

Design, product sales, pest control, and general services: The organization provided design services ($2,250.00 revenue), sales of product income ($912.75 revenue), general services ($503.55 revenue), and pest control services ($110.00 revenue). Program-allocated expenses include a proportionate share of direct program costs.
